game.title: DemonDive
hint.controls: Move: WASD / Arrows   Jump: Space (twice for double jump)   Bolt: J (hold a direction to aim)   Dash: L or Shift   F3: tuning
boon.pyrra.name: Pyrra
boon.pyrra.title: Ember Bloom
boon.pyrra.special_desc: Detonate a close radial wave of Arcane flame.
boon.pyrra.arcane: Arcane hits ignite enemies; repeats extend the burn and trigger small explosions.
boon.pyrra.stacking: Longer, stronger burns; the nova expands and begins chaining explosions.
boon.maris.name: Maris
boon.maris.title: Tidal Orb
boon.maris.special_desc: Send a damaging wave forward that shoves enemies down the lane.
boon.maris.arcane: Bolts grow larger and push enemies farther; later stacks add pierce.
boon.maris.stacking: More size and knockback; then pierce and a second returning wave.
boon.maris.unlock: Free Maris in The Neon Maw.
boon.gaia.name: Gaia
boon.gaia.title: Stoneheart
boon.gaia.special_desc: Raise a short-lived barrier that absorbs damage and bursts into shards.
boon.gaia.arcane: Bolts become heavier, slower, larger, and dramatically more damaging.
boon.gaia.stacking: A broader barrier, harder bolts, and more retaliating stone shards.
boon.gaia.unlock: Free Gaia in The Neon Maw.
boon.zephyra.name: Zephyra
boon.zephyra.title: Gale Needle
boon.zephyra.special_desc: Blast every enemy far away from Milo in both horizontal directions, deal light damage, and reflect nearby hostile shots.
boon.zephyra.arcane: Bolts become smaller, faster, and piercing; excess speed converts into multishot.
boon.zephyra.stacking: More pierce; every third stack creates an additional angled needle.
boon.zephyra.unlock: Free Zephyra in The Neon Maw.
boon.flora.name: Flora
boon.flora.title: Thorn Kiss
boon.flora.special_desc: Vines immobilize the nearest enemy. Rooted enemies cannot move, but they can still fire.
boon.flora.arcane: Hits plant thorn marks; enough marks burst and spread to nearby enemies.
boon.flora.stacking: Marks burst sooner, spread farther, and deal larger area damage.
boon.flora.unlock: Free Flora in The Drowned Court.
boon.voltara.name: Voltara
boon.voltara.title: Chain Spark
boon.voltara.special_desc: Controlled lightning snaps through a small group, briefly stunning without erasing the room.
boon.voltara.arcane: Arcane hits chain lightning into another nearby target.
boon.voltara.passive: Restore Demon Energy when Magic hits.
boon.voltara.stacking: More chain targets, return chains, and stronger energy restoration.
boon.voltara.unlock: Free Voltara in The Drowned Court.
boon.crya.name: Crya
boon.crya.title: Frostbite
boon.crya.special_desc: Slow every enemy in the room for several seconds and cover them in visible frost.
boon.crya.arcane: Hits build slow and then freeze; frozen enemies shatter under heavy damage.
boon.crya.passive: +8% defense while an enemy is slowed, frozen, charmed, or stunned.
boon.crya.stacking: Faster buildup, longer freeze, and more violent shatter damage.
boon.luna.name: Luna
boon.luna.title: Dream Hex
boon.luna.special_desc: Summon a short-lived moon orb that fires whenever Milo does, always in the opposite direction.
boon.luna.arcane: Mark repeated targets; the third hit repeats part of the accumulated damage.
boon.luna.passive: Specials cost 8% less Demon Energy per stack.
boon.luna.stacking: Marks spread on detonation and repeat a larger share of damage.
boon.luna.unlock: Free Luna in The Thunder Jackpot.
boon.solara.name: Solara
boon.solara.title: Radiant Lance
boon.solara.special_desc: Call a brilliant vertical ray onto the strongest living target.
boon.solara.arcane: Bolts become narrow, fast, piercing lances with bonus elite and boss damage.
boon.solara.passive: +12% damage against elites and bosses per stack.
boon.solara.stacking: More pierce, a lingering light field, and a shorter targeting delay.
boon.solara.unlock: Free Solara in The Frozen Basilica.
boon.belladonna.name: Belladonna
boon.belladonna.title: Bottomless Rush
boon.belladonna.special_desc: Eat a weakened enemy directly in front of Milo, executing it and restoring a little Health.
boon.belladonna.arcane: Each pickup increases room damage; full resources turn pickups into protective bursts.
boon.belladonna.passive: Pickups grant short stacking speed buffs.
boon.belladonna.stacking: Longer Rush; full Health or Energy converts pickups into shields and blasts.
boon.belladonna.unlock: Defeat Belladonna in The Neon Maw.
boon.nerissa.name: Nerissa
boon.nerissa.title: Siren Thread
boon.nerissa.special_desc: Charm the nearest enemy. It approaches Milo without attacking and takes extra damage.
boon.nerissa.arcane: Bolts bend toward targets and become more decisive with each stack.
boon.nerissa.stacking: Stronger homing and charm; high stacks add a finishing death note.
boon.nerissa.unlock: Defeat Nerissa in The Drowned Court.
boon.roxyne.name: Roxyne
boon.roxyne.title: Predator's Mark
boon.roxyne.special_desc: Pounce through the target lane with a short invulnerable attack and a dedicated Milo pose.
boon.roxyne.arcane: Bolts deal bonus damage to isolated enemies and marked bosses.
boon.roxyne.passive: +12% damage to enemies with no nearby allies per stack.
boon.roxyne.stacking: Longer pounce, more invulnerability, and a persistent boss mark.
boon.calyptra.name: Calyptra
boon.calyptra.title: Loaded Dice
boon.calyptra.special_desc: Randomly heal, strike an enemy, drop shards, or hurt Milo. An extremely rare roll drops a boon.
boon.calyptra.arcane: Shots roll visible power bands and occasionally become Jackpot bolts.
boon.calyptra.passive: +8% critical damage and favorable luck weight per stack.
boon.calyptra.stacking: Better favorable weighting; high stacks can double a Jackpot result.
boon.calyptra.unlock: Defeat Calyptra in The Thunder Jackpot.
boon.isolde.name: Isolde
boon.isolde.title: Crystal Echo
boon.isolde.special_desc: Create a brief crystal echo that repeats Milo's Arcane casts.
boon.isolde.arcane: Bolts ricochet through room geometry and enemies.
boon.isolde.stacking: More bounces and a second firing echo at high stacks.
boon.isolde.unlock: Defeat Isolde in The Frozen Basilica.
boon.somnia.name: Somnia
boon.somnia.title: Velvet Loop
boon.somnia.special_desc: Fire a dense line of identical dream bolts. All but one are harmless; the real bolt hits extra hard.
boon.somnia.arcane: Every cast creates a delayed echo shot along the same path.
boon.somnia.passive: Recover from hurt and knockback 10% faster per stack.
boon.somnia.stacking: Additional echoes; the decoy gains its own repeating fire.
boon.somnia.unlock: Defeat Somnia in The Forever Motel.
boon.vespera.name: Vespera
boon.vespera.title: Mirror Fang
boon.vespera.special_desc: Raise a clearly visible timed mirror shell that reflects hostile projectiles.
boon.vespera.arcane: Impacts split into mirror shards that cut nearby targets.
boon.vespera.passive: Perfect Dodge timing is more forgiving per stack.
boon.vespera.stacking: More impact shards, longer reflection, and stronger returned shots.
boon.vespera.unlock: Defeat Vespera in the City of a Thousand Faces.
boon.aurelia.name: Aurelia
boon.aurelia.title: Gilded Hunger
boon.aurelia.special_desc: Blind every enemy. Attacks created while blinded visibly miss Milo.
boon.aurelia.arcane: Kills can drop bonus temporary wealth; wealth feeds capped combat power.
boon.aurelia.passive: +15% soul-shard and temporary-currency gain per stack.
boon.aurelia.stacking: Improved conversion and a stronger capped currency-to-power ratio.
boon.aurelia.unlock: Free Aurelia in The Forever Motel.
boon.noctissa.name: Noctissa
boon.noctissa.title: Shade Spiral
boon.noctissa.special_desc: Blink through the target lane, damaging enemies along the vanished path.
boon.noctissa.arcane: Bolts leave lingering shade wounds that continue damaging the struck enemy.
boon.noctissa.passive: +15% ambush damage against unaware or full-health targets per stack.
boon.noctissa.stacking: Stronger, longer shade wounds and a more forceful Damage Blink.
boon.noctissa.unlock: Free Noctissa in the City of a Thousand Faces.
boon.lilith.name: Lilith
boon.lilith.title: Blood Pact
boon.lilith.special_desc: Sacrifice Health for a stacking damage increase that lasts through the current room.
boon.lilith.arcane: Bolts steal life from elites and bosses while Milo is below full Health.
boon.lilith.passive: Deal more damage as Health falls.
boon.lilith.stacking: Stronger elite life-steal; overhealing becomes a blood shield.
boon.seraphine.name: Seraphine
boon.seraphine.title: Halo Ward
boon.seraphine.special_desc: Summon wide horizontal halo charges that orbit Milo and negate incoming hits.
boon.seraphine.arcane: Orbiting fragments periodically fire at nearby enemies.
boon.seraphine.stacking: More fragments, faster regeneration, and fragment projectile fire.
